name: AP_HOLD_CODES
description: AP_HOLD_CODES contains information about hold codes and release codes that you or your Oracle Payables application can place on an invoice.  There is one row for each hold or release code.  When you enter or validate  an invoice, you can select a hold code that you defined in this table.  Your Oracle Payables application also uses these hold codes when it places matching and tax variance holds during Invoice Validation. . Your Oracle Payables application stores translations of HOLD_LOOKUP_CODES in the AP_LOOKUP_CODES table. . This table corresponds to the Invoice Hold and Release Names window.

columns.name: HOLD_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Name of the hold code created to be applied on a invoice.

columns.name: HOLD_TYPE
columns.description: Hold type that is to be applied on a invoice.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_RELEASEABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if hold can be released by user (Y or N)

columns.name: USER_UPDATEABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if hold can be updated by user (Y or N)

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Date when the hold will be inactive.

columns.name: POSTABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates whether this hold should prevent the invoice from being accounted

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Hold description for external users.

columns.name: HOLD_INSTRUCTION
columns.description: Instruction to resolve the hold

columns.name: WAIT_BEFORE_NOTIFY_DAYS
columns.description: Specify the number of days to wait before sending the notification.

columns.name: REMINDER_DAYS
columns.description: Specify the number of days to wait before sending the reminder notification.

columns.name: INITIATE_WORKFLOW_FLAG
columns.description: Enable this to initiate the Hold Negotiation Workflow for the hold.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
